title: client.answer params

callId.description: A client-addressed call's id: a UUID the run's environment mints, which the answer names.

ok.description: true with result: the client did what the call asked; false with error: it could not.

result.description: With ok: what the client's handler answered (null for nothing); for browser.chrome and browser.dock, the verb's outcome.

code.description: unsupported: the client has no handler for the call's kind; handler_failed: its handler failed; or a code a client names.

message.description: What went wrong, a sentence the run reads.

error.description: Why the client could not do what the call asked.

description: A client's answer to a call addressed to it: ok with the result, or not ok with the error; at most 8388608 bytes of either.
